# Coming back to the settings and the song library from a screen they opened, fix/review193 (Minecraft 1.21.11,
# 1280x720, GUI scale 3 (426x240), the demo song). The branch clears a screen's remembered error each time the game puts it
# up again (added()), so an error that came while another screen was in front no longer leaves the settings or the library
# blank when you come back to them. A test game can't make that error; this checks that in a working game coming back looks
# exactly as before. Every shot is the SAME on the branch and on main, and the branch's game log has no "Error in the
# settings" or "Error in the song library" line (no pop-up in any shot).
# - review193-settings: the settings on the Look tab (gui 1).
# - review193-library-over-settings: the song library (grid) opened from them.
# - review193-settings-again: Esc: back on the settings, the Look tab, drawn whole.
# - review193-settings-over-library: the library again, and the settings opened from it (the tab they were last on).
# - review193-library-again: Esc: back on the library, drawn whole.
# - review193-settings-last: Esc: back on the first settings.
# - review193-closed: Esc: the world, no screen.
# Run it on the branch, and with -f mod_ref=main for the old code (the script comes from --ref):
#   gh workflow run screenshots.yml --ref fix/review193 -f version=1.21.11 -f script=.github/checks/review193.txt
#   gh workflow run screenshots.yml --ref fix/review193 -f version=1.21.11 -f mod_ref=main -f script=.github/checks/review193.txt

cmd weather clear
cmd time set noon
cmd gamerule doDaylightCycle false
cmd gamerule advance_time false
look 0 -20
sleep 6
guiscale 3
set libraryView GRID

gui 1
sleep 2
shot review193-settings
screen dev.beli.skylyrics.gui.LibraryScreen
sleep 4
shot review193-library-over-settings
key escape
sleep 2
shot review193-settings-again

screen dev.beli.skylyrics.gui.LibraryScreen
sleep 4
screen dev.beli.skylyrics.gui.SkyLyricsScreen
sleep 2
shot review193-settings-over-library
key escape
sleep 4
shot review193-library-again
key escape
sleep 2
shot review193-settings-last
key escape
sleep 2
shot review193-closed
